CustomField.description: The Form Template Page this stage represents. The LWC reads page metadata (Page_Label__c, Description__c, Estimated_Time__c, Is_Optional__c, Position__c) via this lookup to render the stepper. Restrict delete prevents page deletion while stage records still reference it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The page this stage tracks progress for. One stage record is auto-created per page when a new Form Submission is inserted on a Stages-Mode template.
CustomField.label: Form Template Page
